title: QLabs knowledge source registry
description: Validates knowledge/sources.json. The document is an object with a schema version and an ordered list of source records. Every source_id referenced anywhere else in the knowledge bundle must resolve to an id declared here.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the knowledge file format.

items.description: Source records, in a stable authoring order.

source_record.title: Source record
source_record.description: One bibliographic entry. Licence values that could not be confirmed offline use the literal 'unverified-reference-only', and the reason is recorded in notes.

id.description: Stable identifier cited by rules and other knowledge records.

authors.description: May be empty when authorship could not be confirmed. An empty array is an honest statement of uncertainty, never a placeholder to be filled with a guess.

license.description: A verified licence identifier, or 'unverified-reference-only' when it could not be confirmed. 'restricted-reference-only' marks a source known to prohibit redistribution.

relevant_sections.description: Chapter or section titles, never page numbers.

usage.description: How this source is used by the bundle.

notes.description: Licensing, interpretation and verification notes. Required, because every source in this build carries at least a statement about offline verification.

locator.description: A chapter or section title. Page numbers are forbidden by policy because they cannot be verified offline and are edition-dependent.
